ElectrostaticsOptions
  export interface ElectrostaticsOptions { /** Defaults to `"distance"` (ε = 4r, as ChimeraX's coulombic default). */ readonly model?: DielectricModel; /** * Relative permittivity: ε for `vacuum` (default 1) and `debye` (default * 78.54), or D in ε = D·r for `distance` (default 4). */ readonly epsilon?: number; /** Ionic strength in mol/L for `debye`; defaults to 0.15. */ readonly ionicStrength?: number; /** Kelvin; sets kT and the Debye length. Defaults to 298.15. */ readonly temperature?: number; /** Distances below this (Å) are clamped to it; defaults to 1. */ readonly minDistance?: number; /** Defaults to `"kT/e"`. */ readonly unit?: PotentialUnit }
